Filed on Physical Properties of Metals and Non-metals, the NCERT section (3.1) whose activity burns sulphur and tests the oxide; would have wanted 'Chemical Properties of Non-metals'.
questions.context: Almost all metals combine with oxygen to form metal oxides. Metal oxides are generally basic in nature. But some metal oxides show both basic as well as acidic behaviour. Different metals show different reactivities towards oxygen. Some react vigorously while some do not react at all.
questions.stem:
On burning Sulphur in oxygen a colourless gas is produced.

(i) Write chemical equation for the reaction.

(ii) Name the gas formed.

(iii) State the nature of the gas.

(iv) What will be the action of this on a dry litmus paper ?
